QUICK SETUP FOR APPLE WATCH

1. Install the Facer app on your iPhone
2. Ensure Facer watch app is installed on your Apple Watch
3. Browse thousands of free and premium watch faces
4. Tap ΓÇÿSend to watchΓÇÖ on your favorite face
5. Apple Watch app on your iPhone will open and add the face to your list of faces there and then set it on your Apple Watch (*Note: the face may appear blank/black in the Apple Watch iPhone app until you close and reopen that app after the face downloads)
